Sebelum Green Forest Riverside menjadi t: Before Green Forest Riverside became the place that has now welcomed more than 200 families, groups of friends and colleagues, there was a long journey behind it that was not always smooth.
Kami memulai bukan dari sini. Bertahun-t: We did not start here. For years we tried to build a business in agribusiness, and we failed more than once. Plans stalled halfway, money ran out before results appeared, and there were nights spent wondering whether we had chosen the right path. But through all those failures, there was one thing we never lost: a plot of land by the river that always felt like it held something we had not yet made the most of.
Suatu hari, kami berhenti melihat sungai: One day, we stopped seeing the river as a backdrop and started seeing it as the destination. The sound of the water, the cool shade of the trees around it, the open space so rarely found in everyday city life. All of it had a value we had overlooked. So we decided to change course completely: from agribusiness to agritourism. It was not an easy decision, because it meant rebuilding from scratch with an entirely new way of seeing things.
One day, we stopped seeing the river as a backdrop and started seeing it as the destination.
Tepi sungai yang dulu hanya latar belaka: The riverbank that was once just a backdrop.
Enam bulan membangun, lalu resmi dibuka: Six months of building, then opening day
Enam bulan berikutnya kami habiskan untu: We spent the next six months making it happen. Designing, building, fixing and rebuilding every corner we felt would matter to the people who came. And on 1 April 2025, Green Forest Riverside officially unzipped its tents for the very first time.
Kami tidak berhenti di hari peluncuran i: We did not stop at opening day. In our first year, we were trusted with more than 200 bookings, from family gatherings looking for quality time together to company outings needing a break from targets and deadlines. Every booking is a reminder that our bold decision to change course has brought us to the place where we belong.
Kami masih dalam perjalanan menuju kesta: We are still on our way to real stability, and we do not hide it. That is exactly what makes this story honest. We are growing step by step, learning from every guest who comes, and always improving. Right now we are building an exclusive cabin, one more step towards a warmer, more personal experience for anyone who wants to stay and truly become part of the river and forest around us.
Green Forest Riverside bukan cerita tent: Green Forest Riverside is not a story of instant success. It is a story of how many times we fell before finding a place that truly feels like home. And now, we want to share that home with you.

Jawaban singkat untuk hal-hal yang palin: Quick answers to the questions guests ask most.
Perlu bawa peralatan camping sendiri?: Do I need to bring my own camping gear?
Tidak perlu. Tenda sudah berdiri lengkap: No. Tents are already set up with mattresses, sleeping bags/blankets, pillows, a table, chairs, a grill set, an electric kettle and a power outlet. Just bring a change of clothes, toiletries and any personal medication. We strongly recommend bringing your own food and cooking ingredients.
Setiap tenda berdiri di atas deck kayu d: Every tent stands on a wooden deck under a roof, so the seating area can still be used in light rain. For activities, the schedule may change depending on the weather and river conditions. We will keep you updated.
Bisa untuk gathering kantor atau rombong: Can you host company outings or large groups?
Bisa. Kami melayani rombongan dengan kom: Yes. We host groups with any combination of camping, rafting, ATV and paintball. Send us your estimated group size and dates, and we will prepare a package offer.
Jam berapa check-in dan check-out?: What are the check-in and check-out times?
<b>Check-in</b> mulai pukul 14.00 WIB, <: Check-in is from 2:00 PM WIB and check-out is by 12:00 noon WIB. See the house rules for details.
Berapa DP dan bagaimana cara membayarnya: How much is the deposit and how do I pay?
DP penginapan <b>Rp 150.000 per penyewaa: The accommodation deposit is IDR 150,000 per tent booked. For activities, rafting and ATV can be paid on site, while paintball requires a deposit of at least 50%. Payment is by bank transfer to the account our admin sends when confirming your booking. The balance is due before check-out. Deposits are non-refundable.
Berapa orang yang muat dalam satu tenda?: How many people fit in one tent?
Satu tenda muat 4–6 orang, dengan sarapa: One tent fits 4–6 people, with breakfast included for 4. From the 5th guest onwards, breakfast is IDR 15,000 per person, and extra beds are available.
Bisa datang dengan bus atau Hiace?: Can we come by bus or minibus?
Bisa. Lokasi dapat dicapai mobil pribadi: Yes. The site is reachable by private car; if you are coming by bus or minibus, let us know first so we can direct you to the right parking spot. See location & directions.
Seberapa jauh jarak dari titik parkir ke: How far is it from the parking area to the tents?
Dekat. Hanya 150–200 meter dengan view h: Close by. Just 150–200 metres, with views of the pine forest. For luggage and guests who need a lift, our on-site team is ready with motorbikes.
